lines.t: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali
By the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan
Galilee of the Gentiles
The people who sat in darkness have seen a great light
And upon those who sat in the region in shadow of death
Light has dawned
From my youth I walked in darkness This world knew not your ways
No one taught me of your commandments Or how to walk in truth each day
I looked for truth in all directions But found confusion everywhere
Even those who spoke about you did not bear the fruit of your spirit
My feet did not stand upon your law, so darkness covered me
Temptation ruled my unguarded heart and drained the life from me
Till broken, trembling, barely breathing, I cried out for your light
And you answered me, your presence filled the deep
Light rushed into my darkness And awakened me from sleep
Light is dawned upon the shadows Yet the people love their chains
Holding tightly to deception While their souls dissolve in pain
Oh, I long to shout your name aloud Across the earth and through the night
That every weary heart might hear you and awaken to the light
Teach us the path of life, lead the weary safely home
For we are lost without your spirit, we are dust without your breath
Let your mercy flood the nations and awaken hearts from death
You rescued me from darkness and revealed your truth to me
The volumes of truth laid open and my soul began to breathe
And my whole spirit cried out truth as scales fell from my blinded eyes
You taught me your Sabbath, your law, and how to abide
You called me out from dead traditions and the lies upheld by men
The teachings that had chained my spirit
And kept me from knowing the great I am
You call me to be set apart from every false and crooked way
No longer led by hollow teachings
But by your spirit day to day
Light has dawned upon the shadows
Yet the people still refuse
The living water's flowing freely
While choosing darkness over you
Oh, I long to shout your name aloud
Across the earth and through the night
That every weary heart might hear you
And awaken to the light
Teach us the paths of life
Lead the weary safely home
For we are lost without your spirit
We are dust without your breath
Let your mercy flood the nations
And awaken hearts from death
Everywhere the darkness deepens
And the hearts of men decay
New heights of evil rising daily
As the truth is cast away
And my soul cries out in anguish
For the people still asleep
Lost within the noise and chaos
Far from waters running deep, oh
If only they could taste
Even one glimpse of heaven's peace
To be freed from all the chaos
And the striving of this place
To walk beside the Holy One
And no longer fear the night
For only you can heal the broken
And lead us to the light
Only you can give us life
When this world has lost its way
Only you can lead us safely to this ever
